title: You're Always Living in the Past
hook: You're seeing the Sun as it was, not as it is
script: You're seeing the Sun as it was, not as it is What if the Sun simply switched off right now? You wouldn't know for a while The sunlight hitting your skin has traveled a long way Every time you look at the Sun, you're seeing it as it was in the past But that's not even the strange part The sunlight hitting your skin left the Sun about eight minutes ago This means you are always seeing the Sun as it was eight minutes ago, never as it is right now It's like watching a live feed with an eight-minute delay You could drive over 100 miles in that time, or watch an entire episode of your favorite show But here's the even wilder part: every time you look at the Sun, you are seeing it as it was eight minutes and twenty seconds in the past, never as it is right now Are you team 'living in the past' or team 'living in the present'?
